resources.string: Experimental feature. After changing options, restart the package installer; changes take effect the next time it is invoked. Active/inactive status updates may be delayed. After invoking the package installer, return to this page to check the actual status. Enabling these features may delay installer startup.
Control only advertising promotions in the package installer.
Block local and cloud risk checks in the installer while retaining Android signature and installation authorization checks.
Intercept installer requests for cloud configuration. Existing cache is retained.
Control only installer security guard prompts. This may not take effect.
Prevent the installer from checking information about frequently installed apps.
Prevent the installer from automatically uploading information about apps being installed. This also affects the corresponding cloud risk assessment results, additional verification and promotions.
